steps: Apply the pinned Mia recipe patches to the pinned TensorFold source.
Save its cuda_draft_vocab.txt as draft-vocab-stock.txt in the experiment directory.
Run analyze-vocab.py with /bridge mounted to this directory and /model mounted read-only to the checkpoint.
Apply native-adapter.patch; build the native binary.
Compile bridge.cc against the pinned B12X container Python 3.12 and CUDA 13.
Set TF_B12X_BRIDGE=/bridge/libtf_b12x.so only for the experimental hybrid. Unset it for the native TensorFold control.
limits: The hybrid with cache enabled fails cold/replayed-output exactness. With cache disabled and FP32 router weights it passes four drafted/plain/repeated-plain cases, but its matched TG screen is slower than the native Korean-vocabulary candidate. Not adopted.
Korean vocabulary expansion is tested separately and is not evidence that the B12X hybrid is faster.
Native 256K benchmark results do not qualify 1M context, images, tools, or agent quality.
independent_korean_candidate: Apply only korean-vocab.patch and regenerate cuda_draft_vocab.txt to test vocabulary expansion without the B12X adapter. native-adapter.patch already includes these cardinality updates; do not apply both patches.
launch_template: launch-template.json records the actual tested mounts and settings. Update local source paths when replaying on another checkout. trial-launch.py reads tensorfold-launch.json in the experiment directory; copy the launch template to that filename before using it.

required_mounts./work: experiment directory in the development container
required_mounts./bridge: experiment directory in the B12X runtime container
required_mounts./opt/tensorfold: pinned Mia build, including CUDA kernels and vision helper

vocabulary_result: Full 24-request Korean candidate and fresh vLLM benchmarks completed. TG: Thinking off 36.2311 vs 30.9590 tok/s (+17.03%); Medium 40.4663 vs 34.5507 (+17.12%). All 16 candidate answer/reasoning sequences match stock native TensorFold. All 16 fresh vLLM answer/reasoning sequences match its prior run. Six tool smoke checks passed.

attribution.native_adapter_patch: Changes to pinned TensorFold plus MiaAI-Lab recipe code. Original notices and license texts are included.
attribution.korean_vocabulary_method: Inspired by greatyingzi CJK-DRAFT-VOCAB; Hangul IDs regenerated from the actual local tokenizer, not copied from the Chinese vocabulary.
attribution.b12x: Runtime dependency provided by the pinned vLLM/B12X image. No B12X source code is redistributed in this directory.

hybrid_result: Actual B12X CUDA graphs execute all 48 main routed-expert layers inside TensorFold graphs. No token-time Python call or host activation copy. This prototype is a source-native W4A16 MoE adapter, not a port of every vLLM/B12X optimization; calibrated W4A4 prefill remains disabled.

runtime_dependencies.container: Exact runtime image ID in image-pins.json
runtime_dependencies.python: Python 3.12, torch 2.13.0+cu130, bundled B12X/FlashInfer, Triton, numpy, safetensors from that image
runtime_dependencies.vision_helper: Pinned Mia helper and CUDA cubins under /opt/tensorfold. B12X image uses transformers 5.19.0; the tower startup fingerprint is in the audit. Image correctness is not claimed.
runtime_dependencies.missing_optional_video_package: The experiment installed av==19.0.1 with --no-deps into /bridge/vendor; no other dependency upgrade.

fixed_runtime_options.native_control: TF_B12X_BRIDGE must be unset, not an empty string

vllm_vocab: The installed vLLM native Qwen4Exp MTP head uses config.vocab_size=248320. TensorFold shortlist coverage repair is not an equivalent missing-token fix for vLLM.
